note: Phase 7 only. Formal dry-run bundle in local workerd, authenticated fixture upstreams. CPU is sampled V8, not billed CPU or Cloudflare Free acceptance. 1 cold + 5 warm samples per route. External requests and Cache API calls are reported separately. Cache calls are counted in a separate test wrapper around the same bundle; only its default export is wrapped, with no instrumentation during CPU samples. Prior report remains in git at 7c812b4.

measurements.caveat: Local sampled V8 CPU; excludes idle samples but may omit native CPU and include debugger overhead. Not billed CPU, not Free acceptance. First case also includes isolate startup. 1 cold + 5 warm samples per route; warm means disposable Cache API retained, not cached login.
